recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant green holiday-themed composition featuring a large, central Christmas ornament with a subtle disco-ball grid pattern, surrounded by bokeh sparkles and bold, layered sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Large central ornament acts as the primary container for the main title.
Sparkle and bokeh effects create a sense of depth and festive atmosphere.
High contrast between the red title text and the green background creates a classic holiday palette.
coreInvariants: Monochromatic green background with radial gradient lighting.
White bokeh circles and four-pointed star sparkles.
Large, lowercase-heavy sans-serif typography with thick white outlines.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large spherical ornament occupies the center 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red lowercase title text positioned centrally over the ornament.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large red text, move up to the secondary white text, then down to the bottom subtitle, finally settling on the background sparkles.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The corners are filled with soft green gradients and scattered light effects to keep focus on the center.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant Kelly green background and ornament base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright red for the primary display text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for outlines, secondary text, and light effects.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with bright highlights to simulate glowing light.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif with uniform stroke width.
letterConstructionRules: Thick white outer stroke on all text elements.
Lowercase emphasis for a modern, friendly feel.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'l' and 'e' characters are tightly integrated to form a continuous visual block.

composition.relationshipToImage: layered on top of the ornament

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and colors for consistency.
graphicDevices: Disco ball grid pattern inside the ornament

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, geometric, and modern look of the primary text.
Provides the necessary weight and lowercase character shapes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vibrant green background with a radial gradient. In the center, place a large green Christmas ornament with a subtle yellow-green disco ball grid pattern on its upper half. Surround the ornament with white bokeh circles and bright four-pointed star sparkles of varying sizes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, lowercase sans-serif text in the center. The main title should be red with a thick white outline and tight kerning. Smaller white text should be placed above and below the main title, also in a bold sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the main text red with a thick white outline?
Are there sparkles and bokeh effects present?
Is the central ornament visible behind the text?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the white text outline
Visibility of the disco ball grid
mustRedesign: Exact character spacing of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is perfectly centered over the ornament.
Check that the red and green do not vibrate unpleasantly (use white outlines to separate).
Verify the sparkle effects look like light, not white dots.
Confirm the ornament has a 3D spherical feel through shading.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central holiday icon (ornament) with a high-contrast color scheme (red/green/white) and bold, outlined lowercase typography for a modern festive look.
